rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.2<U+2013>2.4 <U+2013> own field sampling of ~700 topsoil (0<U+2013>10 cm) samples at 100 grid points in the saline-drip-irrigated Taklimakan highway shelterbelt in 2014, with lab moisture and EC measurement and geostatistics. Q2: Abstract, Section 3.2.1, Figures 3<U+2013>5 <U+2013> during the 10-day drip-irrigation cycle (4.8 g/L saline groundwater) soil moisture declined from day 2 to day 8 while EC rose from day 2 to day 6 then fell; Section 3.2.2/Figure 8 <U+2013> salinity rose slightly from spring to autumn; abstract states long-term saline drip irrigation increased soil salinity slightly. Q8: Section 2.2 and 3.2.1 <U+2013> authors note unexpected light rainfall before the day-10 sampling altered both moisture and EC on that date; sampling restricted to the 0<U+2013>10 cm layer and one representative salinity. Q9: Table 1 <U+2013> mean, min<U+2013>max, SD and CV reported for moisture (SD 2.34) and EC (SD 1.66 mS/cm).
rows.notes: The specific figures in the passage (15-day cycle, moisture 27.4%<U+2192>2.4%, EC 0.64<U+2192>3.32 dS/m etc.) do not appear in this study; Table 1 shows moisture 0<U+2013>10% and EC 0.09<U+2013>11.46 mS/cm. The study supports only the qualitative direction (moisture declines and topsoil EC rises within a saline drip cycle). Q3: single method (grid soil sampling with lab analysis); kriging is analysis, not an independent method. Q4: moisture dynamics are measured alongside EC and evaporation/capillary rise is asserted as mechanism, but evaporation itself is not measured and the mechanism is largely cited; answered no in doubt. Q7: texture and stemflow are discussed as correlates/possible contributors, not stated as requirements. Q8 is modest (rainfall confound, shallow layer); Q9 dispersion is for the pooled dataset rather than per sampling date.

notes: Full text appears complete. Primary field study of one shelterbelt site in the Taklimakan Desert under saline-groundwater drip irrigation; focus on spatiotemporal mapping of topsoil moisture and EC, not on quantifying the numeric declines/increases stated in the claim passage.
